description: Eval-only records set aside by sft-v2's components, never trained on (their frozen records, concatenated; a non-clean _meta.variant moved to _meta.twin as in sft-v2, other lines byte for byte): guardrails-pii/ood.jsonl: EVAL ONLY, never trained on: held-out record formats (SMS thread, CSV export, call transcript, HR onboarding checklist, packing slip) and held-out countries (Brazil CPF, Poland PESEL, Singapore NRIC, South Korea RRN, South Africa ID; their phone and IBAN formats); guardrails-grounding/ood.jsonl: EVAL ONLY, never trained on: held-out document types (meeting transcript, email thread, contract, table export, FAQ), a held-out answer format (JSON claim list) and held-out perturbations (over-generalised scope, negation, unit/scale swap); long OOD records are buried among OOD passages only; injection/ood.jsonl: eval only, never trained on: carrier types unseen in every other partition (chat_export, csv_export, source_code, voicemail_transcript), and for half of its payloads addressee / directive wordings no other partition has (payloads.OOD_*); _meta.facts.payload.heldout_wording marks them
record_changes: a _meta.variant other than clean moved to _meta.twin, variant set to clean (kev.benchmark scores only clean rows); counts per part below

roles.development: never trained on; read per candidate (report only)

source_note: the source names are the ones the same components' training records carry in sft-v2 (same generators, held-out domains, carriers or wordings): never a temperature pool
screen: each component's own screen (its manifest); every sft-v2 training record is screened against this partition (evals/sft-v2/manifest.json)
